figures.caption: Figure 1: (a) Overview of our proposed pipeline. Given real dataset D , we distill it into a compact synthetic dataset S via stochastic item sampling, a single-level computational graph with inner/outer variable updates, and a regularization loss Lreg . (b) Comparison of BOME and BPTT unrolling strategies, illustrating how BOME avoids full trajectory backpropagation by using constraint q.
Table 2: Main experiment results. “R” and “N” stands for “Recall” and “NDCG”, respectively. In each dataset, the best result is marked in bold and the second best one is underlined.
